realBrowser.retainedData: Append-only backend login and activity-load audit entries

earlierFailures.cause: Login heading exceeded the default 5-second assertion timeout; HTTP status was not recorded, so the root cause is unknown. An independent login returned 200.
earlierFailures.correction: Assert the login HTTP response and use a 15-second assertion timeout.

earlierFailures.cause: Exact getByLabel lookup did not match the select; accessibility inspection confirmed the correct combobox name.
earlierFailures.correction: Locate the select by its combobox role and accessible name.

limitations: Query fixtures are inserted directly and do not establish checkout or payment lifecycle correctness.
Browser network faults are injected at the route boundary; real authentication, CSRF and backend data queries remain active.
The 15-second network deadline does not roll back a server transaction; existing authentication recovery has separate bounds.
Desktop Chromium and Pixel 7 emulation do not cover Safari or physical devices.
No production-load, reconciliation-endurance or total-memory claim is made.
Mutable sort fields do not provide a database snapshot across pagination requests.
Activity quota/version semantics and reconciliation progress under continuous writes remain separate follow-up design work.
